import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_master_asset"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

width, height = 1920, 1080
bg_color = "#00FF00"

def draw_stickman(draw, frame_idx, total_frames):
    # Blackboard
    draw.rectangle([200, 100, 1720, 800], fill="#2C3E50", outline="#1A252F", width=10)
    
    # Chalk tray
    draw.rectangle([180, 800, 1740, 830], fill="#7F8C8D")
    
    # Fake chalk lines/text on the board
    for i in range(5):
        draw.line([300, 300 + i*80, 800 + (i%3)*150, 300 + i*80], fill="white", width=6)
        
    draw.line([1200, 400, 1500, 400], fill="white", width=6)
    draw.line([1350, 250, 1350, 550], fill="white", width=6)
    
    # Stickman properties
    center_x = 960
    center_y = 650
    head_radius = 90
    
    # Progress 0 to 1
    progress = (frame_idx - 181) / max(1, (total_frames - 1))
    
    # Draw head
    head_bbox = [center_x - head_radius, center_y - head_radius - 180, 
                 center_x + head_radius, center_y + head_radius - 180]
    draw.ellipse(head_bbox, fill="white", outline="black", width=10)
    
    # Excited expression
    # Wide eyes (large ovals)
    eye_w = 15
    eye_h = 25
    draw.ellipse([center_x - 35 - eye_w, center_y - 210 - eye_h,
                  center_x - 35 + eye_w, center_y - 210 + eye_h], fill="black")
    draw.ellipse([center_x + 35 - eye_w, center_y - 210 - eye_h,
                  center_x + 35 + eye_w, center_y - 210 + eye_h], fill="black")
                  
    # Big smile (Arc/Pie)
    # Using a chord to make it look like an open mouth
    draw.chord([center_x - 50, center_y - 170, center_x + 50, center_y - 110], start=0, end=180, fill="black")
    
    # Body
    body_start = (center_x, center_y - 180 + head_radius)
    body_end = (center_x, center_y + 150)
    draw.line([body_start, body_end], fill="black", width=14)
    
    # Legs
    left_leg_end = (center_x - 100, center_y + 350)
    right_leg_end = (center_x + 100, center_y + 350)
    draw.line([body_end, left_leg_end], fill="black", width=14)
    draw.line([body_end, right_leg_end], fill="black", width=14)
    
    # Arms
    # Raising both arms
    shoulder = (center_x, center_y - 40)
    
    # Arm length
    arm_length = 200
    
    # Smooth wave effect
    wave = math.sin(progress * math.pi * 6) * 15 # +/- 15 degrees waving, 3 full waves
    
    # Left arm angle
    start_angle_l = 135
    end_angle_l = 225
    # Ease out interpolation for raising arms
    ease_progress = 1 - (1 - progress) ** 3
    current_angle_l = start_angle_l + (end_angle_l - start_angle_l) * ease_progress + wave
    
    # Right arm angle
    start_angle_r = 45
    end_angle_r = -45
    current_angle_r = start_angle_r + (end_angle_r - start_angle_r) * ease_progress - wave
    
    rad_l = math.radians(current_angle_l)
    left_arm_end = (shoulder[0] + arm_length * math.cos(rad_l), shoulder[1] + arm_length * math.sin(rad_l))
    
    rad_r = math.radians(current_angle_r)
    right_arm_end = (shoulder[0] + arm_length * math.cos(rad_r), shoulder[1] + arm_length * math.sin(rad_r))
    
    draw.line([shoulder, left_arm_end], fill="black", width=14)
    draw.line([shoulder, right_arm_end], fill="black", width=14)

total = 90
for i in range(181, 271):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), bg_color)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    draw_stickman(draw, i, total)
    filename = f"frame_{i}.png"
    img.save(os.path.join(output_dir, filename))

print("Frames 181-270 generated successfully!")
